newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - UNITED ARAB EMIRATES - JULY 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - UNITED ARAB EMIRATES - JULY 27.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates (UAE) press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Ministry of Information and Culture has ordered the shutdown of a number of video and music cassette businesses in Abu Dhabi and Dubai for violating the UAE's copyright law.
- Sheikh Hamdan bin Rashid al-Maktoum, deputy ruler of Dubai, minister of finance and industry, approves four new projects to beautify Dubai.
- Better transport system for Dubai in the offing.
- Bank Muscat al-Ahli al-Omani has raised a $50 million syndicated loan from the international market to fund its medium term lending in U.S. dollars.
- The Pakistani consulate issued 91 exit passes in the first six months of the year to deport Pakistanis found living without documents in violation of UAE immigration laws.
- A leasing venture created by the UAE and Britain this year will lease three aircraft to Jordan under an agreement to be signed soon.
- Kuwait and Yemen to normalise relations in December.
- Dubai Investment Co to launch industrial park in first quarter of 1998.
